title: scint-fibre-fastsim: scintillator and wavelength-shifting fibre optical Monte Carlo for fast detector simulation
description: scint-fibre-fastsim simulates scintillation light in extruded scintillator strips read out by wavelength-shifting fibres, on JAX devices (CPU or GPU, float32 or float64), and generates the optical lookup tables that fast detector simulations draw from. One experiment-neutral optical core (a JAX port of the table mode of the public CRVStandalone Geant4 optical simulation) serves parametric geometry families and a common photosensor interface with SiPM and APD backends; a toy self-check and declared Geant4 compare plans come with it.
references: Mu2e Collaboration, CRVStandalone: standalone Geant4 simulation of the Mu2e Cosmic Ray Veto counters, https://github.com/Mu2e/CRVStandalone
notes: The optical core is a JAX port of the table mode of the public Mu2e/CRVStandalone optical simulation (Apache-2.0); see NOTICE.
